threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look baffled at the number of people who queue for the bus while watching the tube strike unfold on their phones.
Last night on the 159, a guy serenaded the whole bus with Drake. Half the passengers were singing along, made me forget about the strike chaos.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a goat casually munching on a bush outside the Späti. Only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a 24-hour Spätkauf that sells everything from vinyl records to vegan döner at 3 AM. It's pure Berlin energy.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by the quick glance at the BART app after seeing the Civic Center station shut down—nobody else seems to pay attention to the chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 27 bus, holding a bouquet. Muni might be chaotic, but it still knows how to roll out the red carpet sometimes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists flock to the Plaça del Sol, but miss the quiet charm of Carrer de Fray Clara, where local life unfolds in secret corners.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look for the map on their phone at every corner, while the locals navigate by instinct.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver actually waits for you to sit down before taking off. Welcome to the chaos of London travel!
Last night on the N35, saw a guy arguing with a lamp post, swearing it was his ex. The driver just shook his head and kept driving.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a neighbor feeding stray cats while a couple of kids played hopscotch on the sidewalk, both completely unconcerned about the world. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a döner at 3 AM and hear an impromptu techno set blasting from the canal. A true slice of Berlin life!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If they know the difference between Buenavista Park and Buena Vista Park, they’re likely a local. Tourists mix those up all the time.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 91 with a saxophonist playing 'Amazing Grace'—the city’s chaos felt oddly serene for a moment. That’s classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss how quiet Gràcia's streets get after 10 PM; it's a whole different vibe without the crowds and music.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look up at the street signs, trying to decipher the Catalan names instead of just walking on.
